senses.gloss: (= ידי, b. h. הדה) to swing, throw, pitch.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 22a">B. Kam. 22ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 39a">Bets. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>אַדְיֵיה אדויי</he> he threw it off.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a">B. Kam. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>אדייה א׳</he> he pitched it out of his neighbor’s hands.
